rules.statement: A Court Commissioner's report can be used as evidence without further proof, subject to calling him as a witness, under section 18(2) of the Partition Law, No. 21 of 1977, as amended.
rules.supporting_quote: According to section 18(2) of the Partition Law, No. 21 of 1977, as amended, that constitutes evidence without further proof subject to calling him, in terms of the proviso to section 18(2), as a witness.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 18(2) of the Partition Law, No. 21 of 1977, as amended
